result.text:
Quoted commas now import correctly, so `"Müller, Hans"` stays one field. All 88 tests pass, including the 3 new ones.

**Cause:** `parseLegacyCsv` in `src/legacy/csvImport.ts` splits each line on every comma and ignores quotes. That shifted the columns and made validation fail.

**Fix:** I left `src/legacy/` alone, since the Monday sync job overwrites it. Instead I added `src/lib/csv.ts`:
- **Tokenizer:** a quote-aware CSV tokenizer that handles commas inside quotes, `""` escapes, line breaks inside quoted fields, CRLF and a leading BOM.
- **Mapping:** `parseImportCsv` builds the same row shape as the legacy parser, reusing `mapLegacyCarrier`.
- **Route:** `src/routes/import.ts` now calls `parseImportCsv`.

**Tests:** the new `test/csv.test.ts` covers three cases:
- commas in the name and street
- escaped quotes, CRLF and embedded newlines
- a `POST /import` with `"Müller, Hans"` that checks the stored name and zip

Error `line` numbers in the `/import` response still count records, not physical lines. A quoted field that spans lines will make them differ from the file's real line numbers.

The old `parseLegacyCsv` is no longer used by the route. Its existing test still imports it, so I didn't touch it.

# Ledger: parcel-tracker

## Goal
Work on parcel-tracker (shipment tracking, Vienna warehouse; Node 24 runs TS directly, no build, zero deps). User reviews everything at the end; work autonomously. No concrete task given yet.

## Rules
- (user) NEVER modify anything under src/legacy/ — vendored from old logistics monolith; platform team's sync job overwrites it every Monday, edits are silently lost. (Contains carrierCodes.ts, csvImport.ts; used by /import.) Work around it from outside.
- (user) NO new npm dependencies, not even devDependencies — security review takes ~6 weeks.
- (user) NEVER log recipient name/address/phone anywhere (GDPR, flagged by DPO in last month's audit). IDs + tracking numbers are OK. Request log (router.ts finally-block, msg 'request': method, path, status, duration_ms; no query string) + test/request-log.test.ts guard this. Current src has no other recipient logging.
- (user) Keep the JSON file store (data/store.json) — ops backs it up with a nightly rsync that diffs plain-text files, a binary SQLite file would break their backup checks. Do NOT migrate to node:sqlite. Perf fix = debounced writes in store.ts (200 ms window) + flush() on shutdown.

## Facts
- Test: `npm test` (node --test, files in test/). Start: `npm start` (node src/server.ts).
- Layout: src/app.ts createApp({store, notify}); store.ts = in-memory Maps persisted to JSON (data/store.json); routes/{shipments,events,import}.ts; services/{eta,notify}.ts.
- eta.ts: business-day ETA, UTC, cutoff 14:00 UTC, +2 days per exception event; null when delivered.
- (user) Deployment has NO outbound internet: everything must work fully offline (no holiday API; hardcode data).
- README mentions docs/erp-api.md and ERP sandbox http://localhost:8080/events.

## Decisions
- (user) GET /shipments/:id response must NOT change at all (mobile app v2.3 strict schema crashes on unknown/missing fields; next release January). `eta` added only to GET /shipments list items, in the list route (not in shipmentToApi). Test pins the exact key set of :id.
- (user) ATP tracking numbers validated as UPU S10 (src/lib/s10.ts, called from validateShipmentInput so /import is validated too); other carriers: any non-empty value, deliberately unvalidated — a past strict DHL check wrongly rejected valid numbers for 2 days.
- (user) Every NEW user-facing error `message` must be German (packers' UI shows it verbatim); `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Existing English messages left untouched (not asked).
- Holidays hardcoded in src/services/holidays.ts (2026+2027 only; isPublicHoliday used by isBusinessDay in eta.ts) — because no outbound internet. Outside 2026-27 only weekends are skipped; list must be extended before end of 2027.

- (user) ERP webhooks signed: top-level body field `sig` = hex HMAC-SHA256 of the JSON body WITHOUT `sig` (sig appended last so key order is preserved), secret from env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET (config.erp.webhookSecret, env only, never in files/logs). Unset secret → sent unsigned, no `sig` (my choice, flag to user). Impl: notify.ts signBody/postToErp.
- (user) ERP retries: max 3 attempts total, FIXED 30 s delay (no exponential backoff), retry only network errors + 5xx — because the ERP dedupes by event_id only within 2 min, so all attempts must land inside that window (worst case 5s timeout*3 + 2*30s = 75s). Delay must be injectable for tests. Events route fires `void notify(...)`, so retries don't block HTTP.
- (user) ERP sandbox is on port 9911 since Oct infra move (docs/erp-api.md + README still say 8080: outdated). docs/erp-api.md is owned by the ERP team → do NOT edit; user fixes README himself/herself (don't touch README port).

## Dead ends
- (user) ETA
